_README: Reconstructed from the 2026-07-27 export (72 published). swamps[] and the swamp/handoff tags come from the A2 mine, not from the original build — the original list was never saved.

swamps.name: The internal moves and the flight home
swamps.thesis: Every inter-region move on a Turkey first trip funnels through Istanbul, most are booked as separate tickets, and the international return is fixed. Free articles cover fares and carriers; none joins the booking shape to the return.
swamps.open_because: turkey-domestic-flights prescribes only booking habits (book ahead, compare carriers). The connection/margin call is not made in any article.

swamps.name: Medical exposure and what the policy excludes
swamps.thesis: What a US traveler is actually exposed to in Turkey, what a standard policy pays, and the activities that void it (unlicensed scooter/quad, and the balloon).
swamps.open_because: turkey-health-guide is 932 words and prescribes bottled water. Insurance exclusions appear nowhere.

swamps.name: The licence chain
swamps.thesis: US licence vs IDP vs what the rental desk accepts vs what the insurer requires — four different thresholds that free articles state separately and never line up.
swamps.open_because: renting-car-turkey makes the WHERE-to-drive call (avoid Istanbul, coast roads) but leaves the IDP/insurance chain half-stated. The chain, not the placement, is the open decision.

swamps.name: Which coast base, and the moves between
swamps.thesis: Aegean vs Mediterranean bases have different airports, different ferry/gulet access and different onward options; picking the base decides the moves.
swamps.open_because: 2,593 dedicated words, zero call-making sentences detected.

swamps.name: The season that works for one region doesn't for another
swamps.thesis: Coast swimming season, Cappadocia's winter, and the eastern window are three different calendars; a single itinerary has to satisfy all three and the free articles answer only the national question.
swamps.open_because: 1,118 words across 25 articles, ZERO call-making sentences. The national season call is dead (best-time-to-visit-turkey) but the regional collision is untouched.

swamps.name: Getting to the east, and the line you don't cross
swamps.thesis: Eastern Turkey is flight-access, seasonal, and sits next to a Level-4 strip; access, timing and the advisory boundary are stated in separate articles and never joined.
swamps.open_because: ~1,291 words across 13 articles; the 3 detected 'calls' are false positives (a vegetarian guide mentioning the southeast).

swamps.name: Ramadan, Bayram and the days the country moves
swamps.thesis: Religious holidays close sites, fill every domestic seat and empty city centres on different days; the corpus barely mentions them.
swamps.open_because: 209 words across 5 articles, ZERO calls — thinner than Thailand's D-transit was (16 sentences) when it was built from nothing.
swamps.confidence: SPECULATIVE — confirm the stakes are real before spending a batch

dead_decisions.killed_by: turkey-itineraries-overview: 'Always give Cappadocia at least two nights (three is better) so a weather-cancelled balloon morning isn't [wasted]' — and the same call is in the free lead-magnet PDF.
money-in-turkey: 'Always pay and withdraw in lira, never the offered dollar conversion' (x2).
'Always insist on the meter' in 3 articles.
best-time-to-visit-turkey: 'The short answer: spring and fall are ideal nearly everywhere' (13 prescriptive sentences).
renting-car-turkey: 'Most travelers... avoid driving in Istanbul altogether' + 'best enjoyed on the open coast road, not in city gridlock'.
best-cave-hotels-cappadocia + 39 articles: 'A cave hotel is one splurge in Cappadocia that's genuinely worth it' — the base call is made.
museum-pass-turkey states the pass arithmetic flatly; only 330 dedicated words in any case.
